```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR)
library(MASS)
```


```{r}
data(Boston)
```


```{r}
view(Boston)
dim(Boston)
```


```{r}
crim_med=rep(0,nrow(Boston))
crim_med[Boston$crim>median(Boston$crim)]=1
Boston=data.frame(Boston,crim_med)
crim_med=as.factor(crim_med)
set.seed(312)
training_data=sample(nrow(Boston),size=0.75*nrow(Boston))
length(training_data)
```


```{r}
glm_fit=glm(crim_med~.,data=Boston,subset=training_data,family="binomial")
summary(glm_fit)
```


```{r}
glm_probs=predict(glm_fit,Boston[-training_data,],type="response")
glm_pred=rep("No",dim(Boston[-training_data,])[1])
glm_pred[glm_probs>0.5]="Yes"
table(glm_pred,Boston[-training_data,"crim_med"],dnn=c("Predicted","Actual"))
```
